summary: Completed comprehensive testing of Platform 3 dashboard application. Backend APIs are 89.2% functional with minor MongoDB ID issues on newly created records. Frontend is 100% functional with all pages, navigation, and features working correctly.

minor_bugs.root_cause: MongoDB ObjectID vs UUID mismatch - serialize_doc returns _id as id (ObjectID) but queries use UUID field

minor_bugs.impact: Cannot calculate probability for newly created opportunities
minor_bugs.root_cause: Same MongoDB ObjectID vs UUID issue

minor_bugs.issue: Returns 404 when completing newly created activity
minor_bugs.root_cause: Same MongoDB ObjectID vs UUID issue

minor_bugs.issue: Returns 404 when updating progress of newly created goal
minor_bugs.impact: Cannot update progress of newly created goals
minor_bugs.root_cause: Same MongoDB ObjectID vs UUID issue

action_item_for_main_agent: Fix MongoDB ObjectID vs UUID issue in backend: The serialize_doc function converts MongoDB _id (ObjectID) to id field, but update/delete queries use the UUID field from the model. Either: (1) Store UUID in _id field instead of auto-generated ObjectID, or (2) Update queries to use _id field instead of id field. This affects opportunities, activities, and goals update/delete operations for newly created records.
